Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Fleur would love to participate in a short customer story (2–3 minutes) focused on how Redwood helped reduce inference latency and cut per-request costs. We can make two people available: myself (Head of Product) and Alex (CTO).

- Legal needs a standard release and confirmation we won't be asked to disclose PHI; any product demo must use redacted example data.

Could you send a proposed run-of-show, a rough script/talking points, and the release form? Also please include your production partner so we can check availability.

Best,
Sophie

Subject: Re: Customer video — draft script and QA checklist

Adding a quick marketing / legal-minded pass on the content. Below is a lightweight script draft and a checklist we use for customer shoots. Feel free to iterate.

Draft talking points (30–60s each):
- Opening (Sophie): Brief context of Fleur Health and the problem you had
- Problem (Alex): Technical constraints and why latency/cost mattered
- Solution (Sophie): How Redwood helped (feature highlights — batching, routing, dedicated pools)
- Outcome (Alex/Sophie): Specific metrics + business impact
Marketing QA checklist:
- On-camera permissions collected for each speaker (written)
- Brand logo usage approved
- No patient data or screenshots of live PHI — only synthetic/redacted examples
- Sign-off on final cut by Fleur marketing + Redwood comms
Storyboard notes: show cutaways of the team at work, Graf showing latency improvement, and a short demo clip with redacted inputs.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=storyboard_v2 (contains B-roll list and the animated overlay templates)

Attachments: shoot_itinerary_20261129.xlsx (I pre-filled times; please confirm)

Marissa Cole
Senior Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
